method.basis: Independent adversarial reviewers used the rendered preview, interacted with controls and copied actual website citation hrefs; downloaded linked official PDFs and rendered physical pages for visual inspection. Intermediate JSON was used after discovery to reproduce fixes.
method.live_site_limit: Live open.unfck.org navigation aborted in Chromium; workspace preview used. Changes have not been deployed.
method.coverage: Targeted visual verification across views, stages and historical years, plus all 1544 regular-budget country rows checked by the PDF parser. This is not exhaustive certification that every number in every state is printed on its cited page.

fixed_findings.finding: EOSG 2025 OA/XB citations pointed to regular-budget page
fixed_findings.fix: Exact reviewed release table/row corrections, guarded by source identity; generated PPB files refreshed without changing financial values.

fixed_findings.finding: Resident coordinator regular-budget source pointed to special-purpose trust fund
Regular-budget assessment/rate amounts lacked country-specific PDF pages
fixed_findings.fix: Physical pages attached to all 193 country rows for each year 2019–2026; source access added to headline, sidebar and history. Existing rates, amounts, statuses and metadata preserved.

fixed_findings.finding: Headline totals and PKO gross/tax amounts lacked source access
fixed_findings.fix: Added interactive keyboard-accessible citation popovers. Calculated totals explicitly link component rows and do not claim that their sum is printed in a source. Unsupported PPB search zeros now show Not available.

fixed_findings.finding: Digital Library forced PDF downloads prevented fragment navigation
fixed_findings.fix: 14 exact PDF URLs normalized to byte-identical English ODS copies. Remaining unverified download variants explicitly identify download/manual-page behavior. No blind host or chapter replacement.

fixed_findings.finding: Repeated citation links made verification cumbersome
fixed_findings.fix: Long disclosures grouped by document/page set with expandable complete row locators. MINURSO 26 rows/53 anchors becomes 3 anchors; CERF retains its 4 distinct page destinations. Split PDFs sharing a symbol now display period/context.

fixed_findings.finding: CERF 2018 Bulgaria and Catalan Agency names incorrectly combined
fixed_findings.fix: Reviewed export correction scoped to exact source year/fund/page/amount. Raw extraction preserved.

fixed_findings.finding: Historical chart table figures lacked their own source links
fixed_findings.fix: Year/series-specific PDF links added to accessible tables when citation metadata is supplied; tables reveal on keyboard focus. CEB callback-free charts retain existing behavior.

fixed_findings.finding: Trust contributor tile showed category amount while sidebar expanded to all categories without stating scope
fixed_findings.example: Germany 2024 Government tile $539.3M versus net sidebar $539.1M, including -$162.6K inter-organizational flows.
fixed_findings.fix: Tile action and sidebar explicitly state all-category scope; category amounts and headline gain calculation/source access.

fixed_findings.finding: Honour Roll evidence linked generic historical index
fixed_findings.fix: Prefer actual year-specific Honour Roll URL in selected-year and historical status links. Payment-status HTML is retained as its real source rather than fabricated PDF citations.

fixed_findings.finding: Money source popovers had no visible affordance, and PKO cost trend was labelled funding source
fixed_findings.fix: Dotted underlines added to primary PPB/trust amount triggers; PKO trend caption now names budget groups.

remaining_findings.finding: The strict every-number-in-PDF condition is not yet certified. Some secondary figures still lack individual source access
